summary: Cue Biopharma filed an 8-K reporting the mutually agreed resignation of four board members (Jill Broadfoot, Peter Kiener, Frank Morich, Patrick Verheyen) effective May 29, 2026, with no stated disagreement. Concurrently, the board appointed Sumita Ray as Chief Legal Compliance Officer and Corporate Secretary, and Michael Meluzio as Vice President and Principal Accounting Officer, effective June 1, 2026. These abrupt board departures, while not due to policy disagreements, represent a significant governance shift. No financial terms or advisor recommendations are noted. Watch for any underlying strategic rationale or future board reconstitution.
